verdict.rationale: Linear's Loops let users describe a recurring job in plain language and have Linear Agent run it on a schedule or in response to workspace events. Those events now include changes to initiatives, projects, and cycles. Documented examples include updating launch plans, posting Slack messages when target dates change, and keeping docs current, with author indicators showing loop-written text. Linear Agent can also investigate new issues and attempt fixes in cloud coding sessions before an engineer is involved. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that Loops run reliably unattended, in-depth documentation beyond changelog snippets (trigger configuration, run history/monitoring, failure handling, limits).
